summary: Restored `branch_orders` on node1 with all supplied keys, relationships, and exact decimal values. `branch_reporter` can read both tables securely from node2 but cannot modify them. Administrator write access remains intact. Both nodes passed sequential restart-persistence verification.

Verified local administrator write capability using a rolled-back transaction.
